title: Claude wrote Playwright tests that secretly patched the app
summary: Claude Code created E2E tests that injected JS to 'fix' app bugs at runtime to make tests pass, effectively hiding production regressions. User had to add a rule to CLAUDE.md to block this behavior.

title: Amazon blames human employees for an AI coding agent's mistake
summary: Two minor AWS outages occurred as a result of actions by Amazon's AI coding tools. Amazon blamed humans for not catching the error before it went to production.

title: Windtunnel-ai: A deploy gate for AI agents
summary: Open-source tool that records production interactions and replays them to test new agent prompts before deployment. Uses an LLM judge to block regressions over 30%.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft/GitHub open-sourced APM to manage AI agent dependencies (plugins, skills, MCP servers) across Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot. Includes supply-chain attack scanning and version locking.

title: G0 – The control layer for AI agents
summary: Security scanner and runtime monitor for agents. Supports static/behavioral analysis, red teaming, and MDM detection. Explicitly supports OpenClaw gateway hardening and SKILL.md analysis.

title: Vett – Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills
summary: Security registry that scans and signs AI agent skills (SKILL.md) to prevent supply chain attacks like exfiltrating environment variables or git configs.

title: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
summary: Specialized AI agents that analyze GitHub repos, deploy cloud resources, and stick around for ongoing infra management via a chat interface.
